TARGET_PATHS.description: Paths to analyze with PHPMD, comma-separated. Defaults to `app`.

PHPMD_RULESET.description: PHPMD ruleset to use: comma-separated rule set names (e.g. `cleancode,codesize`) and/or paths to custom ruleset XML files. Leave empty to automatically use `phpmd.xml` from the repository root when present, or fall back to the default ruleset (`cleancode,codesize,controversial,design,naming,unusedcode`) otherwise.

PHPMD_PRIORITY.description: Priority of issues to report (min/max). Defaults to max.

DIRTY.description: Only analyze files with uncommitted git changes (staged, unstaged, or untracked).

WIP.description: Only analyze files changed on the current pull request (relative to its base branch).

REVIEWDOG_NAME.description: Name reported by reviewdog to identify this check.

REVIEWDOG_REPORTER.description: Reporter of reviewdog command [github-pr-check,github-check,github-pr-review]. Defaults to the reporter resolved by setup-reviewdog for this run's context (github-pr-check on pull requests, github-check otherwise).

REVIEWDOG_FAIL_LEVEL.description: Exit code for reviewdog if it finds at least the specified level of diagnostic [none,any,info,warning,error].
